decisions.reason: As an older, fairly standard compilation in a genre that is somewhat less central to the firm's specialist collector identity, it is likely to fall below aspiration and be dropped so shelf space and attention can return to stronger core releases.

Because this illustrated series extends the firm's curated physical-media offer and provides learning across several models, management would likely keep it while results remain uncertain but strategically relevant.
A reissued jazz vinyl LP fits the firm's reissue capabilities, collector customer base, and vinyl-focused niche well, so it is more likely to meet aspiration and be retained.

The multi-disc box set matches the firm's established collector-oriented business, and despite tying up inventory capital it is close enough to the core offer that management would probably give it more time.

With only limited web prominence and little differentiation from the firm's broader catalog, this compilation CD is the most likely to miss aspirations and be removed in favor of better-performing core or new projects.
